camel_example: aliyun amqp-open CreateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --instanceId 'amqp-cn-000000000' --signature 22c2d7d1769cb53c5a6d9213248e2de524000000 --secretSign 4c1a6367ce4c4255e9617326f9133ac635000000 --userName Mjo0000000000000000 --accountAccessKey yourAccessKeyID --createTimestamp 1671175303522
description_en: When an open-source client accesses an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ server, it must provide a username and password for authentication. ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ lets you generate a username and password from an AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret provided by Resource Access Management (RAM)
description_zh: 开源客户端访问云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版服务端时，需要传入用户名和密码进行权限认证，认证通过才允许访问服务端。云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版支持通过阿里云访问控制（RAM）的AccessKey和AccessKey Secret生成用户名和密码
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open create-account --instance-id amqp-cn-000000000 --account-access-key yourAccessKeyID --user-name Mjo0000000000000000 --signature 22c2d7d1769cb53c5a6d9213248e2de524000000 --create-timestamp 1671175303522 --secret-sign 4c1a6367ce4c4255e9617326f9133ac635000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance. This specifies the instance for which you want to create a static username and password
parameters.help_zh: 消息队列RabbitMQ版实例的ID，表示您需要为哪个实例创建静态用户名密码
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey ID of your Alibaba Cloud account or RAM user. For more information about how to obtain an AccessKey ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116401.html.

If you use the AccessKey of a RAM user to create a static username and password to access ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ and to send and receive messages, make sure that the RAM user is granted the required permissions. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146559.html
parameters.help_zh:
您的阿里云账号或RAM用户的AccessKey ID。获取方式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116401.html。

如果您使用RAM用户的AccessKey创建的静态用户名密码接入消息队列RabbitMQ版并收发消息，请确保该RAM用户已被授予收发消息权限。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146559.html
parameters.name: account_access_key

parameters.help_en:
The static username that you want to create.

The value of this parameter is a Base64-encoded string that is constructed from the instance ID and the AccessKey ID. For more information about how to calculate the value, see the Username calculation sample code section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
待创建的静态用户名。

该参数值由实例ID和AccessKey ID构造的字符串经过Base64编码得出，具体计算方法，请参见本文中的用户名计算示例代码
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The signature. The system calculates the static password based on the signature, the AccessKey secret signature, and the username.

The signature is calculated using the HmacSHA1 algorithm on the creation timestamp of the specified username and the AccessKey ID. For more information about how to calculate the signature, see the Signature algorithm sample code section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
签名，系统将根据请求参数中的签名、AccessKey Secret签名和用户名计算出静态用户密码。

签名由指定的用户名创建时间戳和AccessKey ID进行HmacSHA1加密算法计算得出。具体计算方法，请参见本文中的签名算法示例代码
parameters.name: signature

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp that indicates when the username and password are created. Unit: milliseconds.

This timestamp is used to calculate the static password. You can customize this value. This is not the timestamp that the system generates when the username and password are created
parameters.help_zh:
指定该用户名密码创建的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

该时间戳用于计算静态用户密码，由您自定义设置。不是系统生成用户名密码时的时间戳
parameters.name: create_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The signature of the AccessKey secret. The system calculates the static password based on the signature, the AccessKey secret signature, and the username.

The AccessKey secret signature is calculated using the HmacSHA1 algorithm on the creation timestamp of the specified username and the AccessKey ID. For more information about how to calculate the signature, see the Signature algorithm sample code section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
AccessKey Secret签名，系统将根据请求参数中的签名、AccessKey Secret签名和用户名计算出静态用户密码。

AccessKey Secret签名由指定的用户名创建时间戳和AccessKey ID进行HmacSHA1加密算法计算得出。具体计算方法，请参见本文中的签名算法示例代码
parameters.name: secret_sign

parameters.help_en: The remarks on the static user
parameters.name: remark

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful

AccessKey.description_en: The AccessKey ID that is used to create the username and password
AccessKey.description_zh: 创建该用户名密码所使用的AccessKey ID

CreateTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp when the username and password were created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimeStamp.description_zh: 创建用户名密码的时间戳。单位：毫秒

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance

MasterUId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account or RAM user that owns the AccessKey. The AccessKey is used to create the static username and password
MasterUId.description_zh: 创建静态用户名密码的AccessKey所属的阿里云账号或RAM用户的账号ID

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
